listing.name: Amped 2 (Amped2-Recomp)
listing.summary: An experimental Linux x86-64 Amped 2 port. The Windows preview is explicitly unplayable and very slow, with only Wine/Proton testing. Use your own PAL/Europe original-Xbox disc: title 4D530041, XDK 5558, default.xbe SHA-1 38e63cd016bf084d999e0a911933a52191bfc378. The project supports a full Redump ISO, game-partition XISO or extracted folder. Keep every disc file in game_files/, with default.xbe directly at its root; other versions are untested. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
